content: विप्लु €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To float about, swing to and for, fluctuate. .²2 To drift (in the sea), be scattered; यदि न स्यान्नरपतिः सम्यङ्नेता ततः प्रजा . अकर्णधारा जलधौ विप्लवेतेह नौरिव .. <ls>H. 3. 2</ls>; <ls>Pt. 3. 72</ls>. .²3 To be confused (as mind). .²4 To be ruined or destroyed. .²5 To fail. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to float or swim. .²2 To divulge, spread abroad. .²3 To teach (to unworthy persons); शरणागतं परित्यज्य वेदं विप्लाव्य च द्विजः <ls>Ms. 11. 198</ls>. .²4 To cause to fail, spoil, mar; गुणानामायथातथ्यादर्थं विप्लावयन्ति ये <ls>Śi. 2. 56</ls>. .²5 To confound, bewilder.
